To close your Light Blue checking and open a new checking plus a personal savings account, I’ll need to verify your identity first (required for opening/closing accounts). After verification I can: 1) close the specified checking account, 2) open the new checking account you choose, and 3) open a personal savings account and, if you want, transfer an opening deposit from your checking now. A few important notes from our policies: - We must verify you before accessing or changing accounts. To verify, I’ll need you to confirm any 2 of these: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. - Personal savings accounts require the customer to have at least one active Rho-Bank checking account that has been open at least 14 days. If you’ve already closed or moved funds out of your only checking, we may need to open the new checking first and wait 14 days before opening the personal savings (unless you already have another eligible checking). - Some checking accounts provide APY boosts to linked savings; only the single highest checking boost applies. To help you pick the “absolute highest possible interest” for your $10,000, I can: a) look up current savings classes and which checking(s) give the biggest boost for personal customers, or b) if you already have a target checking type in mind, open the recommended savings class now (subject to the eligibility rules above). Would you like to proceed with verification now? If yes, please confirm which two of the following you can provide: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), the email on file, phone number on file, or the address on file — and also confirm whether you currently have any active Rho-Bank checking accounts besides the Light Blue account (if so, please name them). If you prefer, I can instead connect you to a human agent."}

- Highest single effective APY available for a personal savings account in the docs: Gold Account (savings) has a base 5.5% APY. When paired with a Green checking account, Green provides a +0.75% linked‑checking boost to Gold savings. That gives an effective APY of 5.5% + 0.75% = 6.25% on the Gold savings balance. However — Green checking (per its product doc) declines transactions that exceed available balance and does not provide overdraft transfers; it does not offer the linked‑savings overdraft protection you requested.

Blue checking also supports overdraft protection transfers (so it meets your overdraft protection requirement). Silver Plus savings (in our docs) offers tiered APYs (lower tier and higher tier; the higher tier is 4.5%) and up to $25/month in ATM fee rebates.
